articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: US Financial 15 Split Corp. Preferred Dividend Declared. TORONTO, Feb. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- US Financial 15 Split Corp ("US Financial 15") declares its monthly distribution of $0.07275 for each Preferred share, or 10.00% annually based on the previous month end net asset value. Distributions are payable March 10, 2026 to shareholders on record as at February 27, 2026. articles.title: WD Unifies its Professional Content Creator Storage Portfolio Under the G-DRIVE® Brand
articles.mainIdea: WD Unifies its Professional Content Creator Storage Portfolio Under the G-DRIVE® Brand
articles.summary: Business Wire: WD Unifies its Professional Content Creator Storage Portfolio Under the G-DRIVE® Brand. SAN JOSE, Calif., February 19, 2026--WD (Nasdaq: WDC) today announced the re-launch of its G-DRIVE® brand as the unified identity for its content creator and creative professional external storage product portfolio. The brand consolidation brings together high-capacity, high-performance storage solutions under a single name brand – G-DRIVE® – known for its quality, performance, and reliability. Related tickers mentioned: SNDK, WDC.
